## New information that supersedes review assumptions

- [DEA's October 14 order](https://www.dea.gov/sites/default/files/2026-10/Proposed%20Marijuana%20Rescheduling_Order%20for%20Response%20to%20Motion%20to%20Reopen%20Hearing.pdf) confirms an October 9 government response, October 13 supporting responses, pending motions, a continued stay, and an October 21 response deadline. Do not repeat that the October 13 filings are unknown.
- [AB 2249, chaptered text](https://legiscan.com/CA/text/AB2249/id/3458233): section 26141 becomes operative January 1, 2028. Existing child-appeal restrictions remain applicable before then.
- [IRS priority plan](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-counsel/2026-2027-initial-pgp.pdf) was released September 29, not first published October 6. A project appearing on the plan is not issued guidance.

## Maintenance and unresolved watch items

Monthly accuracy check on the 13th; additional checks October 22, November 16/23/30, and December 7/11/12. The November 13 monthly check covers the first federal transition and New Jersey deadline. Checks report source-backed replacements; publishing is a separate action.

| Trigger | Review action |
| --- | --- |
| October 21 response deadline, then later DEA orders | Check the docket October 22 and on later reviews. Do not assume the deadline resolves the case. |
| November 12 / November 13 | Verify the narrow federal exclusions actually took effect; update tense only after checking. Check the New Jersey transition separately. |
| December 11 | Verify enactment of any delay or replacement. If unchanged, update future-tense descriptions after the date. |
| DEA registration, labeling, or inspection guidance | Update covered activities and requirements from issued guidance; portal access is not proof of registration. |
| IRS Section 280E guidance | Update allocation and transition statements only from issued guidance; do not promise retroactive relief. |
| Hemp bills or SAFE Banking advance | Distinguish introduced, passed one chamber, enacted, and operative. |
| California DCC proposals finalize | Update each rule separately; existing pesticide rule is already in effect. |
| Colorado EPR court order | Check actual scope and affected parties before describing a pause. |
| Medicare/CBD challenge, Ohio product caps, New York reporting, Colorado METRC contract, other state hemp changes | Research primary records before adding any claim to a public article. These remain leads. |
